response.content:
The password-recovery process should consist of two distinct steps: requesting password recovery to an email and then resetting the password with a token sent to that email. Each step should be handled through separate URLs and screens. The login screen itself should only present options related to original login information and links for accessing the password recovery process, without displaying the entire password recovery flow at once. Thus, these processes are designed to maintain a separation of functionality and enhance user experience, allowing for a clean interface that minimizes confusion during recovery attempts.

**Conclusion:** The password-recovery request and password-reset screens differ in their purpose and function. The recovery request is focused on initiating the reset process by gathering the user's email, while the reset screen is where the actual password change occurs after the user has received and verified a token. Therefore, having separate URLs for these steps is necessary to facilitate this division of tasks effectively.

Evidence supporting these details includes claims that both processes should not be shown together on the login screen and that each should utilize different URLs and screens for clarity and security.

sourceContexts.text:
Login Screen
The login screen should show only Login information and links to Access to Password Recovery
Password Recovery should have two steps:
Request password recovery to an email
And reset the password with the token sent
Both should be different urls and screens the user Will acces.
Both should not be showed on the login screen

Maintenance screens
The screen maintenance should work this way:
When you enter them a grid with existing data should be shown.
From the grid you can delete a record or navigate to one to update it
Also you can push a button to créate a new record.
Both editing and creating screens are different from the consult screen where the grid is shown.

This applies to projects, users, and timelines screens

TimeLine Maintenance
When we enter a Project we Will see it's timeline as a conversation.
We should see the different entries of the timeline: By each entry we Will see the firs 500 characters of the entry of the timeline 
and a link to download the artifacts that generated that text if they are available.
We could click on it to navigate to a full entry screen where we Will see:
Full text of the entry
The user that created that entry
Links to download the artifacts(files) that created that entry
An option to add a new file to the entry

We Will see the same when creating the entry.
Supported documents are: PDF, Word, Excel, .md files

Project structure
DataAccess Logic
Acceses postgre database with entityframework that acceses the database.
We have a general class that is inherited by entity and allows performing the CRUD against the entities
It should have validations, Transactional save of multiple entities

Business Logic
Allows cross entity operations and transactional savings
AI and RAG operations Will be in this layer although they aren't defined now.

WebApi
Exposes the entities and information by entity to the UI with ODataQueries and Create, Delete and UpdateOperations

UI
A react application that has all the screens and requirements to mantain the entities and interact with them.
Identified screens
Login
Password recovery
User maintenance
Project maintenance
Project TimeLine list
TimeLineWorkingScreen where add entries for an specific timeline.

Thechnology considerations
.NET 10
MicrosoftAgentFramework for AI operations with Harness
EntityFramework Core
Postgree database
React on UI

You must deploy the database with initial records. Everythin must run with dotnet run.
The app must run correctly.
Divide projects for
Database
DataAccessLogic
BusinessLogic
UI+WebApi

The table UserRoles are the roles that are selectable for a user.
It should not have the UserId
The User should have the IDUserRole field with a value selected from UserRole table.
In the existing record the user should have the role Admin

{"content":"Based on the available information regarding the ProjectTimeline login screen:

1. The login screen is intended to display only login-related information, such as fields for entering user credentials and links for password recovery. It should not include additional navigation headers or menus.
2. Specific claims made about the login screen include:
   - It should show only login information and possibly a link to access password recovery (Fact ID: 826ff4f0-e8b7-43c1-8545-65832e0a1947).
   - Password recovery steps are not to be displayed on the login screen (Fact ID: 0c45e5ec-0505-4d06-ba36-f65b25267c46).

Therefore, the consensus viewed from the claims is that the ProjectTimeline login screen should not display the application’s normal navigation header and menus. Instead, it should focus on login functionalities only.

Landing page
In the landing page we should have a left tool bar  with the different menus the user can Access.
That menú bar can be shown and hided with the hamburger button. So the screen can be used in mobile.
The User Profile should be on it's own page and be accesed from té toolbar
The Users sceeen should be on it's own page and be accesed from the toolbar
The Projects screen should be on it's own page and be accesed from the toolbar

TimeLine Maintenance
When we enter a Project we Will see it's timeline as a conversation.
We should see the different entries of the timeline: By each entry we Will see the firs 500 characters of the entry of the timeline 
and a link to download the artifacts that generated that text if they are available.
We could click on it to navigate to a full entry screen where we Will see:
Full text of the entry
The user that created that entry
Links to download the artifacts(files) that created that entry
An option to add a new file to the entry

We Will see the same when creating the entry.
Supported documents are: PDF, Word, Excel, .md files

Maintenance screens
The screen maintenance should work this way:
When you enter them a grid with existing data should be shown.
From the grid you can delete a record or navigate to one to update it
Also you can push a button to créate a new record.
Both editing and creating screens are different from the consult screen where the grid is shown.

This applies to projects, users, and timelines screens

User Roles Maintenance
The table UserRoles are the roles that are selectable for a user.
It should not have the UserId
The User should have the IDUserRole field with a value selected from UserRole table.
In the existing record the user should have the role Admin

Project structure
DataAccess Logic
Acceses postgre database with entityframework that acceses the database.
We have a general class that is inherited by entity and allows performing the CRUD against the entities
It should have validations, Transactional save of multiple entities

Business Logic
Allows cross entity operations and transactional savings
AI and RAG operations Will be in this layer although they aren't defined now.

WebApi
Exposes the entities and information by entity to the UI with ODataQueries and Create, Delete and UpdateOperations

UI
A react application that has all the screens and requirements to mantain the entities and interact with them.
Identified screens
Login
Password recovery
User maintenance
Project maintenance
Project TimeLine list
TimeLineWorkingScreen where add entries for an specific timeline.

Thechnology considerations
.NET 10
MicrosoftAgentFramework for AI operations with Harness
EntityFramework Core
Postgree database
React on UI

You must deploy the database with initial records. Everythin must run with dotnet run.
The app must run correctly.
Divide projects for
Database
DataAccessLogic
BusinessLogic
UI+WebApi

response.content:
### UserRole.IsAdmin
UserRole.IsAdmin typically indicates a role assigned to users in an application that grants them administrative privileges. The role allows users with this designation to perform tasks such as managing other users, altering system settings, and accessing sensitive information that is restricted from regular users.

### Application Roles in Initial Specification
According to the data retrieved, the initial specification includes a table called `UserRoles`, which defines roles selectable for a user. Here's a key note from the specification:
- Users can select from available roles, one of which must be the Admin role in the existing records.

The specific context for this from the table `UserRoles` is as follows:
- "The table UserRoles are the roles that are selectable for a user. It should not have the UserId. The User should have the IDUserRole field with a value selected from UserRole table. In the existing record, the user should have the role Admin." This reinforces the notion that being assigned the Admin role is essential for proper functionality in this application context.

sourceContexts.text:
TimeLine Maintenance
When we enter a Project we Will see it's timeline as a conversation.
We should see the different entries of the timeline: By each entry we Will see the firs 500 characters of the entry of the timeline 
and a link to download the artifacts that generated that text if they are available.
We could click on it to navigate to a full entry screen where we Will see:
Full text of the entry
The user that created that entry
Links to download the artifacts(files) that created that entry
An option to add a new file to the entry

We Will see the same when creating the entry.
Supported documents are: PDF, Word, Excel, .md files

User Roles Maintenance
The table UserRoles are the roles that are selectable for a user.
It should not have the UserId
The User should have the IDUserRole field with a value selected from UserRole table.
In the existing record the user should have the role Admin

Landing page
In the landing page we should have a left tool bar  with the different menus the user can Access.
That menú bar can be shown and hided with the hamburger button. So the screen can be used in mobile.
The User Profile should be on it's own page and be accesed from té toolbar
The Users sceeen should be on it's own page and be accesed from the toolbar
The Projects screen should be on it's own page and be accesed from the toolbar

Maintenance screens
The screen maintenance should work this way:
When you enter them a grid with existing data should be shown.
From the grid you can delete a record or navigate to one to update it
Also you can push a button to créate a new record.
Both editing and creating screens are different from the consult screen where the grid is shown.

This applies to projects, users, and timelines screens

contents.text: {"content":"A user's application role is linked through the `IDUserRole` field in the `User` table, which references a role selected from the `UserRoles` table. This relational setup ensures that a user is assigned a specific role (like Admin) without the need to include a `UserId` field in the `UserRoles` table itself. In fact, it is noted that the `UserRoles` table should not contain the `UserId` because it is designed for defining selectable roles rather than linking users directly. response.content:
The timeline allows access to different entries in a structured manner. Each entry displays the first 500 characters of its content, facilitating a quick overview of the timeline's events. Additionally, there are links provided for users to download any artifacts associated with the entries, should those files be available. This setup enables smooth navigation; users can access the full entry screen to view complete texts, identify the user who created the entry, and further manage file attachments.

Specifically, the timeline is presented as a conversation when entering a project, and it must be accessed from the project consultation screen rather than a sidebar. Supported document types for these attachments include PDF, Word, Excel, and Markdown (.md) files.

sourceContexts.text:
User Roles Maintenance
The table UserRoles are the roles that are selectable for a user.
It should not have the UserId
The User should have the IDUserRole field with a value selected from UserRole table.
In the existing record the user should have the role Admin

Landing page
In the landing page we should have a left tool bar  with the different menus the user can Access.
That menú bar can be shown and hided with the hamburger button. So the screen can be used in mobile.
The User Profile should be on it's own page and be accesed from té toolbar
The Users sceeen should be on it's own page and be accesed from the toolbar
The Projects screen should be on it's own page and be accesed from the toolbar

Login Screen
The login screen should show only Login information and links to Access to Password Recovery
Password Recovery should have two steps:
Request password recovery to an email
And reset the password with the token sent
Both should be different urls and screens the user Will acces.
Both should not be showed on the login screen

Maintenance screens
The screen maintenance should work this way:
When you enter them a grid with existing data should be shown.
From the grid you can delete a record or navigate to one to update it
Also you can push a button to créate a new record.
Both editing and creating screens are different from the consult screen where the grid is shown.

This applies to projects, users, and timelines screens

TimeLine Maintenance Details
Timeline maintenance should be accessed from the Project consultaton screen
Not from the sidebar.
You Access a timeline inside a Project.

TimeLine Maintenance
When we enter a Project we Will see it's timeline as a conversation.
We should see the different entries of the timeline: By each entry we Will see the firs 500 characters of the entry of the timeline 
and a link to download the artifacts that generated that text if they are available.
We could click on it to navigate to a full entry screen where we Will see:
Full text of the entry
The user that created that entry
Links to download the artifacts(files) that created that entry
An option to add a new file to the entry

We Will see the same when creating the entry.
Supported documents are: PDF, Word, Excel, .md files

response.content:
When viewing a complete timeline entry, the following creator information, entry text, and file-adding controls are required:

1. **Creator Information**: The full entry screen will show the user who created that entry. 
2. **Entry Text**: The full entry screen will display the entire text of the entry. Additionally, for each entry in the timeline, the first 500 characters will be visible initially, which can provide a snapshot of the entry before accessing the full text. 
3. **File-Adding Controls**: There will be an option on the full entry screen to add new files to the entry. Furthermore, links will be included to download the artifacts (files) that were associated with or generated the timeline entry, if they are available.

{"content":"When viewing a complete timeline entry, the following creator information, entry text, and file-adding controls are required:

1. **Creator Information**: The full entry screen will show the user who created that entry. 
2. **Entry Text**: The full entry screen will display the entire text of the entry. Additionally, for each entry in the timeline, the first 500 characters will be visible initially, which can provide a snapshot of the entry before accessing the full text. 
3. **File-Adding Controls**: There will be an option on the full entry screen to add new files to the entry. Furthermore, links will be included to download the artifacts (files) that were associated with or generated the timeline entry, if they are available.","citedFactIds":["89345f33-3623-497a-8eb4-0e844cabd91e","cfc1f388-deec-4939-9cc9-073bcf22623b","2120ca93-333a-4624-ab6c-ec81861c4c85","6a040fbc-5a50-428b-9e2f-a8fd0cff3c73","2e309574-6be3-4f10-b26c-9613012684fc","cdc4a0a7-1a6e-4276-8871-d5237b909a63","ebb2a2a2-e62b-4684-9bb1-91bbc65dcd93","77450402-8b47-4ece-aff7-98c38ea68013","9e7ecbac-45ce-4d23-ad80-130711385423"],"citedContextEvidenceIds":["a75b6ebb-351b-41bf-b7f2-d9097089173e"]}

response.content:
When two TimeLineEntry entries are added to the same timeline at the same time, they will both receive the same EntryNumber, which indicates a simultaneous incorporation into the timeline. In the current context, entries are identified with their EntryNumbers, and if they are added concurrently, they share the same numerical identifier unless specified otherwise. This means they will be displayed together as part of a conversation within the project timeline interface, commonly allowing users to see the first 500 characters of each entry along with functionalities related to downloading associated artifacts. 

The evidence suggests that while adding two entries concurrently does not seem to affect their individual functionalities, their visual presentation and related operations within the timeline may maintain a sequence allowing users to engage with them effectively. If both entries received an EntryNumber of 5 as seen in the evidence from the retrieved contexts, this indicates concurrency in their addition to the timeline.

sourceContexts.text:
Login Screen
The login screen should show only Login information and links to Access to Password Recovery
Password Recovery should have two steps:
Request password recovery to an email
And reset the password with the token sent
Both should be different urls and screens the user Will acces.
Both should not be showed on the login screen

TimeLine Maintenance
When we enter a Project we Will see it's timeline as a conversation.
We should see the different entries of the timeline: By each entry we Will see the firs 500 characters of the entry of the timeline 
and a link to download the artifacts that generated that text if they are available.
We could click on it to navigate to a full entry screen where we Will see:
Full text of the entry
The user that created that entry
Links to download the artifacts(files) that created that entry
An option to add a new file to the entry

We Will see the same when creating the entry.
Supported documents are: PDF, Word, Excel, .md files

User Roles Maintenance
The table UserRoles are the roles that are selectable for a user.
It should not have the UserId
The User should have the IDUserRole field with a value selected from UserRole table.
In the existing record the user should have the role Admin

Landing page
In the landing page we should have a left tool bar  with the different menus the user can Access.
That menú bar can be shown and hided with the hamburger button. So the screen can be used in mobile.
The User Profile should be on it's own page and be accesed from té toolbar
The Users sceeen should be on it's own page and be accesed from the toolbar
The Projects screen should be on it's own page and be accesed from the toolbar

Project structure
DataAccess Logic
Acceses postgre database with entityframework that acceses the database.
We have a general class that is inherited by entity and allows performing the CRUD against the entities
It should have validations, Transactional save of multiple entities

Business Logic
Allows cross entity operations and transactional savings
AI and RAG operations Will be in this layer although they aren't defined now.

WebApi
Exposes the entities and information by entity to the UI with ODataQueries and Create, Delete and UpdateOperations

UI
A react application that has all the screens and requirements to mantain the entities and interact with them.
Identified screens
Login
Password recovery
User maintenance
Project maintenance
Project TimeLine list
TimeLineWorkingScreen where add entries for an specific timeline.

Thechnology considerations
.NET 10
MicrosoftAgentFramework for AI operations with Harness
EntityFramework Core
Postgree database
React on UI

You must deploy the database with initial records. Everythin must run with dotnet run.
The app must run correctly.
Divide projects for
Database
DataAccessLogic
BusinessLogic
UI+WebApi

Maintenance screens
The screen maintenance should work this way:
When you enter them a grid with existing data should be shown.
From the grid you can delete a record or navigate to one to update it
Also you can push a button to créate a new record.
Both editing and creating screens are different from the consult screen where the grid is shown.

This applies to projects, users, and timelines screens

Contexts.Text:
TimeLine Maintenance
When we enter a Project we Will see it's timeline as a conversation.
We should see the different entries of the timeline: By each entry we Will see the firs 500 characters of the entry of the timeline 
and a link to download the artifacts that generated that text if they are available.
We could click on it to navigate to a full entry screen where we Will see:
Full text of the entry
The user that created that entry
Links to download the artifacts(files) that created that entry
An option to add a new file to the entry

We Will see the same when creating the entry.
Supported documents are: PDF, Word, Excel, .md files

User Roles Maintenance
The table UserRoles are the roles that are selectable for a user.
It should not have the UserId
The User should have the IDUserRole field with a value selected from UserRole table.
In the existing record the user should have the role Admin

Login Screen
The login screen should show only Login information and links to Access to Password Recovery
Password Recovery should have two steps:
Request password recovery to an email
And reset the password with the token sent
Both should be different urls and screens the user Will acces.
Both should not be showed on the login screen

Maintenance screens
The screen maintenance should work this way:
When you enter them a grid with existing data should be shown.
From the grid you can delete a record or navigate to one to update it
Also you can push a button to créate a new record.
Both editing and creating screens are different from the consult screen where the grid is shown.

This applies to projects, users, and timelines screens

Landing page
In the landing page we should have a left tool bar  with the different menus the user can Access.
That menú bar can be shown and hided with the hamburger button. So the screen can be used in mobile.
The User Profile should be on it's own page and be accesed from té toolbar
The Users sceeen should be on it's own page and be accesed from the toolbar
The Projects screen should be on it's own page and be accesed from the toolbar

Project structure
DataAccess Logic
Acceses postgre database with entityframework that acceses the database.
We have a general class that is inherited by entity and allows performing the CRUD against the entities
It should have validations, Transactional save of multiple entities

Business Logic
Allows cross entity operations and transactional savings
AI and RAG operations Will be in this layer although they aren't defined now.

WebApi
Exposes the entities and information by entity to the UI with ODataQueries and Create, Delete and UpdateOperations

UI
A react application that has all the screens and requirements to mantain the entities and interact with them.
Identified screens
Login
Password recovery
User maintenance
Project maintenance
Project TimeLine list
TimeLineWorkingScreen where add entries for an specific timeline.

Thechnology considerations
.NET 10
MicrosoftAgentFramework for AI operations with Harness
EntityFramework Core
Postgree database
React on UI

You must deploy the database with initial records. Everythin must run with dotnet run.
The app must run correctly.
Divide projects for
Database
DataAccessLogic
BusinessLogic
UI+WebApi

A timeline snapshot must include specific date and summary information, which generally encapsulates different entries and provides an overview of a project. Each entry typically consists of the first 500 characters of the timeline content to give users a brief insight into the details available. Furthermore, the timeline is regarded as a conversation where various entries can be viewed.

The snapshot number assigned for these timelines is typically scoped within the specific project context, reflecting distinct entries that relate to that project. Users can access timeline maintenance via the project's consultation screen, which emphasizes that the timeline is part of project management functionalities.

response.content: TimeLineSnapshotEntries associates a snapshot with timeline entries through an organized display of the entries as part of a project timeline view. When a user enters a project, they see the timeline presented in a conversational format, showcasing various entries. Each entry reflects the first 500 characters of its content along with potential artifacts that generated it. This structured approach enables users to navigate through different timeline entries easily. Furthermore, from any entry, users can access a full entry screen displaying the complete text, details about the user who created the entry, and links to any associated artifacts or documents. Each entry can include functionalities for adding new files and downloading related artifacts, thus intertwining snapshots with the timeline entries effectively.

User Roles Maintenance
The table UserRoles are the roles that are selectable for a user.
It should not have the UserId
The User should have the IDUserRole field with a value selected from UserRole table.
In the existing record the user should have the role Admin

TimeLine Maintenance Details
Timeline maintenance should be accessed from the Project consultaton screen
Not from the sidebar.
You Access a timeline inside a Project.

Maintenance screens
The screen maintenance should work this way:
When you enter them a grid with existing data should be shown.
From the grid you can delete a record or navigate to one to update it
Also you can push a button to créate a new record.
Both editing and creating screens are different from the consult screen where the grid is shown.

This applies to projects, users, and timelines screens

TimeLine Maintenance
When we enter a Project we Will see it's timeline as a conversation.
We should see the different entries of the timeline: By each entry we Will see the firs 500 characters of the entry of the timeline 
and a link to download the artifacts that generated that text if they are available.
We could click on it to navigate to a full entry screen where we Will see:
Full text of the entry
The user that created that entry
Links to download the artifacts(files) that created that entry
An option to add a new file to the entry

We Will see the same when creating the entry.
Supported documents are: PDF, Word, Excel, .md files

response.content:
Files attached to a TimeLineEntry are typically stored in a structured way within a project's directory. When users access a timeline within a project, they can see the timeline as a conversation with different entries. For each timeline entry, the first 500 characters of the entry are displayed, along with a link to download any associated artifacts (files) that were generated by that entry, such as PDFs, Word documents, Excel spreadsheets, or markdown (.md) files.

The full entry screen includes options to view the full text of the entry, see the user who created the entry, download the attached artifacts, and add new files to the entry if necessary. These functionalities are consistent whether users are creating a new entry or viewing an existing one, indicating a systematic approach to managing entries and their associated files within the project context. 

In summary, files are linked to a TimeLineEntry through download links provided in the full entry screen, and they are stored in the specific project’s folder structure associated with that timeline.

response.content:
To create a timeline Git tag or checkpoint that effectively groups entries together, the following information must be stored and utilized:

1. **Entry Identification**: Each entry in the timeline must have a unique identifier to differentiate them, which allows accessing specific entries.

2. **Entry Content**: The first 500 characters of each entry must be visible, providing a brief overview or summary. This helps users get context without requiring them to load the entire entry immediately.

3. **Author Information**: It is important to store the identity of the user who created each entry. This can include user roles and the specific user identification related to user privileges.

4. **Artifact Links**: Each entry may link to downloadable artifacts that contributed to its content. This is indicated when available, making it easier for users to access referenced materials.

5. **Supported Document Types**: The entries can include various document types such as PDFs, Word documents, Excel spreadsheets, and .md files. This diversity in document types ensures flexibility for what can be attached or referenced in a timeline.

6. **Management Access**: The timeline maintenance must be accessible within the project consultation screen. This design helps maintain an integrated view within the broader project context, rather than being siloed.

7. **Navigation Links**: It should be easy for users to navigate from the timeline entry to a full screen displaying all relevant details, including functionality for adding new files or modifying existing entries.

8. **Creation Functionality**: The same functionalities available for viewing entries should be present when creating new entries, ensuring consistency in user experience.

In essence, a timeline Git tag or checkpoint requires structured metadata that encapsulates the essential elements of each entry while allowing for ease of navigation and interaction within the project context.

{"content":"To create a timeline Git tag or checkpoint that effectively groups entries together, the following information must be stored and utilized:

1. **Entry Identification**: Each entry in the timeline must have a unique identifier to differentiate them, which allows accessing specific entries.

2. **Entry Content**: The first 500 characters of each entry must be visible, providing a brief overview or summary. This helps users get context without requiring them to load the entire entry immediately.

3. **Author Information**: It is important to store the identity of the user who created each entry. This can include user roles and the specific user identification related to user privileges.

4. **Artifact Links**: Each entry may link to downloadable artifacts that contributed to its content. This is indicated when available, making it easier for users to access referenced materials.

5. **Supported Document Types**: The entries can include various document types such as PDFs, Word documents, Excel spreadsheets, and .md files. This diversity in document types ensures flexibility for what can be attached or referenced in a timeline.

6. **Management Access**: The timeline maintenance must be accessible within the project consultation screen. This design helps maintain an integrated view within the broader project context, rather than being siloed.

7. **Navigation Links**: It should be easy for users to navigate from the timeline entry to a full screen displaying all relevant details, including functionality for adding new files or modifying existing entries.

8. **Creation Functionality**: The same functionalities available for viewing entries should be present when creating new entries, ensuring consistency in user experience.

In essence, a timeline Git tag or checkpoint requires structured metadata that encapsulates the essential elements of each entry while allowing for ease of navigation and interaction within the project context.","citedFactIds":["75d66ef5-4c38-43d8-82c7-e27429ed5e77","89345f33-3623-497a-8eb4-0e844cabd91e","9e7ecbac-45ce-4d23-ad80-130711385423","cfc1f388-deec-4939-9cc9-073bcf22623b","eb04cca1-b265-4821-893d-fd6301e4c360","27892b6b-a2b5-4c53-95f2-42e8593ed3e6","6a040fbc-5a50-428b-9e2f-a8fd0cff3c73","7b0114db-1b8b-4109-bf34-ca2cf1d09cf7"],"citedContextEvidenceIds":["79d33799-8f9b-4e4a-a67c-2e410b36d59c","f53482ec-82a4-43fe-b278-661ecf240e7a","ea5d81af-7d57-4472-96b2-786f3f5796b0","f5d76193-b74c-4abd-a541-7b3fb8d1f2cb","3ebd60bc-9300-4d03-a229-991156f45162","4d809504-2539-4ce2-b85c-9c715a2d7e67"]}

Contexts.Text:
TimeLine Maintenance
When we enter a Project we Will see it's timeline as a conversation.
We should see the different entries of the timeline: By each entry we Will see the firs 500 characters of the entry of the timeline 
and a link to download the artifacts that generated that text if they are available.
We could click on it to navigate to a full entry screen where we Will see:
Full text of the entry
The user that created that entry
Links to download the artifacts(files) that created that entry
An option to add a new file to the entry

We Will see the same when creating the entry.
Supported documents are: PDF, Word, Excel, .md files

TimeLine Maintenance Details
Timeline maintenance should be accessed from the Project consultaton screen
Not from the sidebar.
You Access a timeline inside a Project.

Maintenance screens
The screen maintenance should work this way:
When you enter them a grid with existing data should be shown.
From the grid you can delete a record or navigate to one to update it
Also you can push a button to créate a new record.
Both editing and creating screens are different from the consult screen where the grid is shown.

This applies to projects, users, and timelines screens

Project structure
DataAccess Logic
Acceses postgre database with entityframework that acceses the database.
We have a general class that is inherited by entity and allows performing the CRUD against the entities
It should have validations, Transactional save of multiple entities

Business Logic
Allows cross entity operations and transactional savings
AI and RAG operations Will be in this layer although they aren't defined now.

WebApi
Exposes the entities and information by entity to the UI with ODataQueries and Create, Delete and UpdateOperations

UI
A react application that has all the screens and requirements to mantain the entities and interact with them.
Identified screens
Login
Password recovery
User maintenance
Project maintenance
Project TimeLine list
TimeLineWorkingScreen where add entries for an specific timeline.

Thechnology considerations
.NET 10
MicrosoftAgentFramework for AI operations with Harness
EntityFramework Core
Postgree database
React on UI

You must deploy the database with initial records. Everythin must run with dotnet run.
The app must run correctly.
Divide projects for
Database
DataAccessLogic
BusinessLogic
UI+WebApi

The Reviewer role in ProjectTimeline typically does not have the authority to change another user's role. The role that must be assigned to a user must come from the IDUserRole field, which links to a specific value from the UserRoles table. It suggests that the ability to change user roles is likely limited to users with higher privileges, such as Admin. In existing contexts, it is indicated that users may be required to have certain roles, such as Admin, to perform specific actions, including changing roles.

The source mentions: "In the existing record, the user should have the role Admin" and "The User must have the IDUserRole field with a value selected from UserRoles table." This indicates that only users who are properly authorized (likely Admin roles) can manage or change the roles assigned to other users.

sourceContexts.text:
Maintenance screens
The screen maintenance should work this way:
When you enter them a grid with existing data should be shown.
From the grid you can delete a record or navigate to one to update it
Also you can push a button to créate a new record.
Both editing and creating screens are different from the consult screen where the grid is shown.

This applies to projects, users, and timelines screens

TimeLine Maintenance
When we enter a Project we Will see it's timeline as a conversation.
We should see the different entries of the timeline: By each entry we Will see the firs 500 characters of the entry of the timeline 
and a link to download the artifacts that generated that text if they are available.
We could click on it to navigate to a full entry screen where we Will see:
Full text of the entry
The user that created that entry
Links to download the artifacts(files) that created that entry
An option to add a new file to the entry

We Will see the same when creating the entry.
Supported documents are: PDF, Word, Excel, .md files

User Roles Maintenance
The table UserRoles are the roles that are selectable for a user.
It should not have the UserId
The User should have the IDUserRole field with a value selected from UserRole table.
In the existing record the user should have the role Admin

Landing page
In the landing page we should have a left tool bar  with the different menus the user can Access.
That menú bar can be shown and hided with the hamburger button. So the screen can be used in mobile.
The User Profile should be on it's own page and be accesed from té toolbar
The Users sceeen should be on it's own page and be accesed from the toolbar
The Projects screen should be on it's own page and be accesed from the toolbar

sourceContexts.text:
TimeLine Maintenance Details
Timeline maintenance should be accessed from the Project consultaton screen
Not from the sidebar.
You Access a timeline inside a Project.

Project structure
DataAccess Logic
Acceses postgre database with entityframework that acceses the database.
We have a general class that is inherited by entity and allows performing the CRUD against the entities
It should have validations, Transactional save of multiple entities

Business Logic
Allows cross entity operations and transactional savings
AI and RAG operations Will be in this layer although they aren't defined now.

WebApi
Exposes the entities and information by entity to the UI with ODataQueries and Create, Delete and UpdateOperations

UI
A react application that has all the screens and requirements to mantain the entities and interact with them.
Identified screens
Login
Password recovery
User maintenance
Project maintenance
Project TimeLine list
TimeLineWorkingScreen where add entries for an specific timeline.

Thechnology considerations
.NET 10
MicrosoftAgentFramework for AI operations with Harness
EntityFramework Core
Postgree database
React on UI

You must deploy the database with initial records. Everythin must run with dotnet run.
The app must run correctly.
Divide projects for
Database
DataAccessLogic
BusinessLogic
UI+WebApi

TimeLine Maintenance
When we enter a Project we Will see it's timeline as a conversation.
We should see the different entries of the timeline: By each entry we Will see the firs 500 characters of the entry of the timeline 
and a link to download the artifacts that generated that text if they are available.
We could click on it to navigate to a full entry screen where we Will see:
Full text of the entry
The user that created that entry
Links to download the artifacts(files) that created that entry
An option to add a new file to the entry

We Will see the same when creating the entry.
Supported documents are: PDF, Word, Excel, .md files

Maintenance screens
The screen maintenance should work this way:
When you enter them a grid with existing data should be shown.
From the grid you can delete a record or navigate to one to update it
Also you can push a button to créate a new record.
Both editing and creating screens are different from the consult screen where the grid is shown.

This applies to projects, users, and timelines screens

Login Screen
The login screen should show only Login information and links to Access to Password Recovery
Password Recovery should have two steps:
Request password recovery to an email
And reset the password with the token sent
Both should be different urls and screens the user Will acces.
Both should not be showed on the login screen

Contexts.Text:
TimeLine Maintenance
When we enter a Project we Will see it's timeline as a conversation.
We should see the different entries of the timeline: By each entry we Will see the firs 500 characters of the entry of the timeline 
and a link to download the artifacts that generated that text if they are available.
We could click on it to navigate to a full entry screen where we Will see:
Full text of the entry
The user that created that entry
Links to download the artifacts(files) that created that entry
An option to add a new file to the entry

We Will see the same when creating the entry.
Supported documents are: PDF, Word, Excel, .md files

Login Screen
The login screen should show only Login information and links to Access to Password Recovery
Password Recovery should have two steps:
Request password recovery to an email
And reset the password with the token sent
Both should be different urls and screens the user Will acces.
Both should not be showed on the login screen

{"content":"The search results confirmed several specifications related to user interface features and navigation for a project management tool. Specific details include:

1. **Timeline Display**: Each entry in the timeline will display the first 500 characters along with a link to download associated artifacts if available. Complete access to the full entry will be achieved by navigating to a dedicated full screen.
2. **User Navigation**: Users can seamlessly navigate to view the complete text of any entry from the main timeline overview.
3. **Password Recovery Process**: The login interface will strictly provide options for login and a link to recover passwords, ensuring that both steps of the recovery process are managed on distinct screens and URLs.

### Summary of Specifications:
- For timeline entries, the implementation assures visibility of the first 500 characters followed by options for further actions.
- Password recovery steps are segregated from the login screen to improve user focus and workflow.
- The usability concerns regarding navigation to full entry screens and the structured presentation of elements were noted as completed and consistent across specifications.
